Wondering why Moyes didn't get the same backing, having had an actual harder being the initial succesor to Fergusson and without the same money spent on players. I have nothing against LVG, but don't like how some people are reasoning some aspects of this season when the exact same could have applied to Moyes.

Because people didn't respect Moyes. The players were against him and the support as well. I was chewed alive everytime I showed him support in the reddevils subreddit. Van Gaal just came of a great run in the World Cup and Moyes had nothing. That's the only reason why LvG is getting such staunch support. Charlton supported Moyes though. What did Moyes in were his decisions or lack thereof especially regarding Rooney who was in poor form but still played.

LvG has balls. He took off Di Maria at half time and took of Falcão just as he won us a crucial penalty. However, he needs to do more. This football is atrocious. We're getting points though. Moyes attacked but had no end product. Van Gaal passes about but with little end product which beats none. Moyes was also backstabbed by Rio, Vidic, and mostly the silent snake, Giggs. If you see the job he's doing at Sociedad, they're playing better football than before when the other management were there. It's down to the players you have. Their players know how to move the ball, when to cross, when to shoot, and how to defend/attack altogether.

We had absolute bottle jobs in our team last year (still there) who did nothing for us when we needed them. They still suck and we need new players who play better football. Time for a manager is important. We didn't win with Fergie till five years later. Modern football is a results business. I reckon that's why LvG is doing his best with what he has to meet the demands whilst waiting for the off season to hit the market.
